preconditions.description: The input s must be a string.

postconditions.description: The returned string is a palindrome.
The returned string starts with the original string s.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == len(s) + min((len(s) - len(s[:i]) for i in range(len(s) + 1) if (s[:i] + s[i:][::-1]) == (s[:i] + s[i:][::-1])[::-1]), default=len(s))
postconditions.description: The returned string is the shortest palindrome formed by adding characters only to the front of s.
